item: HCR-3 follow-up: what the prompt hook serves, against explicit recall and against lean
code_ref: 125af25 (the tree of youknowfred/hippo#240: main at 76fc113 plus the 4B and 8B count entries)
privacy: The live corpus, its fixture and its episode log are private: counts and distributions only, no query, prompt or memory name.
method: The rig of HCR-3.count.evidence (the real hook body, recall_hook.run_recall with hook=True, a fresh session per prompt, clean env, user tier off; corpora: tests/golden_corpus, the starter packs, this repo's own corpus copied to a temp project) with one addition: every stage a memory can leave the hook at is captured per prompt. Stages, in order: abstained (the corroboration gate), not_in_pool (recall returned rows but not this one), floor_collapsed (the memory is on the always-loaded MEMORY.md floor, so the hook prints it on a collapse line and gives it no row), low_signal (the count rule: no evidence of its own), row_cap (the count rule's narrow row budget), lane_share, past_k, render_budget (walked but cut by the character budget), hit (on a rendered pointer line). A hard-set row is filed under the furthest stage any of its expected memories reached. 'Explicit' is recall() at k=10, HCR-3's acceptance measure. The 300 replayed prompts are the newest distinct human prompts of the live project's episode log on the day of the run (229 inject on lean here against 227 in HCR-3.count.evidence: the log moved on).

lean_count_rule.question: HCR-3.count.evidence recorded that lean's own entry (band 0.05, wide 0.18, five narrow rows) costs the starter-pack hard set 5 rows in hook mode. Which part of the rule cuts them, and what does each alternative cost?
lean_count_rule.attribution_note: Each lost row was re-run with one part relaxed: band (HIPPO_COUNT_BAND=9, every row earned), the narrow cap (recall_count._NARROW_ROWS=10), both, and wide (HIPPO_COUNT_WIDE=0, which is the rule off). cap_alone: the expected memory had evidence and sat past the fifth earned row. band_alone: it had none and relaxing the band was enough. band_and_cap: it needed both.
lean_count_rule.grid_note: Per cell and corpus: hard-set hits, MRR, rows lost against the rule off, probes abstaining, rows served on leaked off-topic probes, mean and median rows per injecting hard-set prompt; on the live corpus also the 300-prompt replay.
reading: Reproduced: starter packs 29/32 with the rule off, 24/32 on (MRR 0.664 -> 0.646). Golden 18/18 and the live corpus 26/38 lose nothing.

All 5 lost rows are multi-hop. 2 are cut by the five-row cap alone (the expected memory is earned, at pool position 7 to 11), 1 by the band alone, 2 need both relaxed. The wide margin is not what separates them: four of the five prompts clear the floor by 0.04 to 0.17, under 0.18, and one has no row over the floor at all.

No cell of the grid restores all 5; only the rule off does. The best cells (band 0.12 or more, 7 or 8 rows) reach 28/32 and give back most of the rule's saving: replay rows per injecting prompt 5.21 -> 7.22 or more, rows on leaked live probes 23 -> 48 or more.

The cheap lever is the cap. Six rows instead of five, band and wide unchanged: packs 24 -> 26/32, live and golden unchanged, replay 5.21 -> 5.74 rows per injecting prompt (1,193 -> 1,314 rows, +10%), leaked live-probe rows 23 -> 24. Seven rows adds nothing over six at band 0.05.
Widening the band is the expensive lever: 0.05 -> 0.08 alone restores no packs row and takes leaked live-probe rows 23 -> 34.
Not measured here: the two field corpora the rule was calibrated on (emgl, Skyline). HOT-8 chose five rows over three on emgl's replay; a change to the cap should be read there first.

hook_vs_explicit_live_corpus.question: Hook mode reads 26/38 on the live corpus for lean and high alike, against 33/38 and 31/38 in explicit mode. Why?
reading: The floor collapse, and nothing else of size. 7 of the 38 rows expect a memory that is on the always-loaded floor (11 names). The hook never gives such a memory a row: it is already in context, and the hook prints it on a collapse line. The measure counts only full pointer lines, so each of those rows reads as a miss in hook mode.

Lean: of the 33 rows explicit recall finds, 25 are hits in the hook, 6 end floor_collapsed, 1 is cut by the count rule (low_signal; past_k with the rule off), 1 is not in the hook's pool. 1 row explicit misses is found by the hook (its pool is deeper: k plus the floor's size).
High (4B): of the 31 rows explicit recall finds, 25 are hits and all 6 others end floor_collapsed. Of the 7 explicit misses the hook finds 1 and collapses 1 more onto the floor.
High (8B): of the 34 rows explicit recall finds, 25 are hits, 7 end floor_collapsed, 1 is past the tenth row and 1 is not in the hook's pool. Of the 4 explicit misses the hook finds 1.

Counting a floor-collapsed expected memory as found: lean 32/38 (MRR 0.576), 4B 33/38 (MRR 0.624), 8B 33/38 (MRR 0.592). On that reading hook mode is one row under explicit mode for lean (33) and for the 8B (34) and two over it for the 4B (31), and both high embedders are one row ahead of lean.

The gate, the lanes and the render budget cost nothing here: no row of any arm ends abstained, lane_share or render_budget. The count rule changes no hit on any arm (26 with it on or off); the one lean row it cuts is past the tenth row with the rule off.

replay_injection_gap.question: High injects on more of the 300 replayed prompts than lean (269 vs 227 in HCR-3.count.evidence). Why?
reading: This run: lean injects on 229 of 300, high on 271. 14 prompts never reach recall on either arm (hygiene), 14 abstain on both, 228 inject on both, 43 inject on high only, 1 on lean only.
All 43 high-only prompts are prompts lean's corroboration gate abstained on. High admitted 39 of them by the gate's 'strong' path (the best cosine alone, at or over 0.48) and 4 by corroboration.

By admission path: 260 of its 271 injecting prompts are admitted by 'strong', against 52 of lean's 229. Lean's 'strong' (0.76) sits 0.16 over its floor and most real prompts fall under it (median best cosine 0.046 under), so lean leans on corroboration (128) and lexical evidence (49). High's 'strong' (0.48) sits 0.06 over its floor and the median real prompt clears it by 0.109.

But 'strong' is only the path that fires first, not the reason. Raising it alone changes little: at strong 0.60 (support still 0.46) 262 prompts inject, and at 0.70, 261. The prompts it stops admitting are admitted by corroboration instead, because 'support' (0.46) sits 0.04 over the floor: almost any memory that is in both lanes' top 10 has a cosine over it.

'support' is the lever. Strong 0.60 with support 0.52: 242 inject. Support 0.56: 230. Support 0.60: 227, level with lean's 229. Past that it is flat (223 at 0.66/0.66 and at 0.72/0.72): those prompts share two or more terms with a memory both lanes rank, which no cosine threshold touches.

None of those cells changes a hard-set hit, an MRR, a probe's abstention or a leaked-probe row on any of the three corpora, in explicit or in hook mode (explicit 18/18, 32/32, 31/38; hook 18/18, 31/32, 26/38; live adjacent probes 8 of 12 abstain throughout). HCR-3 tried strong up to 0.60 and support up to 0.48 and found the same flatness; it had no replay to see the difference on.

The off-topic probes do not show this: none of the 35 on the live corpus reaches 'strong' in either space (high's closest is 0.060 under). The 4B's gate was placed in the gap between hard-set queries and off-topic probes, and that gap is real. Replayed prompts are a third population, mostly work talk about this very project, and in the 4B's space they sit with the on-topic queries.
Whether the 43 extra injections are wanted cannot be read from counts: the replayed prompts carry no labels. On them high serves a median of 5 rows (8 of the 43 clear the wide margin).

The row count is the same mechanism one step later: 184 of high's 271 injecting prompts clear its wide margin (0.14 over the floor) and get up to k rows; 36 of lean's 229 clear lean's (0.18). Median rows per injecting prompt: high 10, lean 5.
Lanes play no part: this corpus declares no journal or behavior lane, and every served row on both arms is a fact row.
The 8B on the same replay: 262 inject (241 by 'strong', 20 corroborated, 1 lexical); 36 prompts inject on it and not on lean, 3 on lean and not on it. Its gate (0.50/0.48) was not swept here.

gate_threshold_sweep_high.note: The 4B's two gate thresholds (recall_abstain._COSINE_BY_MODEL: strong/support) patched in for one process each; floor 0.42 and the count entry as shipped. Per cell: explicit and hook-mode hard-set hits and MRR, probes abstaining and rows on leaked probes on all three corpora; on the live corpus the 300-prompt replay with the admission path of each injecting prompt.

chosen.rationale: The cell 0.6/0.6 against the shipped 0.48/0.46: replay prompts injecting 271 -> 227 (lean 229); explicit and hook-mode hard-set hits and MRR, probe abstention and leaked-probe rows identical on golden, starter packs and the live corpus, with the count entry on. Not known: whether the 44 prompts it stops were wanted (the replay carries no labels).
chosen.not_changed: The 8B's gate (0.50/0.48) was not swept and is unchanged.
